AFTERCARE

Heal it right

A great tattoo needs good care. Your artist will give you full instructions, and here is the quick guide.

First days

Keep it clean and gently washed. Pat dry and let it breathe.

Moisturize

Use a thin layer of recommended aftercare lotion. Do not over-apply.

Protect it

Avoid direct sun, soaking in water and picking at scabs while it heals.

FAQ

Good to know

How much will my tattoo cost?

Every piece is quoted after a consultation, based on size, detail, placement and the time it takes.

Do I need to bring a design?

No. Bring ideas, references and photos, and we will design something custom with you.

Does it hurt?

Everyone feels it differently, and it depends on the area. Tell us your concerns and we will plan the session around you.

How long does a session take?

Small pieces can take an hour or two. Large work like sleeves and back pieces is done over several sessions.

What about age and ID?

Age and ID requirements apply. You must be old enough to be tattooed where we work, and we will confirm what to bring.

Do you take a deposit?

Deposits are common for custom work and are confirmed when we agree your booking.

How do I look after my new tattoo?

We give you full aftercare instructions. See the quick guide above, and always follow your artist's advice.

Ready for ink that speaks?
